subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Psychology of Fraudsters
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Psychology of Fraudsters.

hook.text: Most fraudsters don't think of themselves as criminals. They're just borrowing. They'll pay it back. They deserve it.

buildup.text: Rationalization is the most dangerous leg of the fraud triangle. It turns theft into 'temporary borrowing.'

discovery.text: Fraudsters often start small, testing boundaries. When nobody notices, the amounts escalate quickly.

twist.text: Many fraudsters are model employees. Their dedication masks the fact they can't take a vacation without being caught.

climax.text: Fraud psychology shows us that good people do bad things when the right conditions align.

punchline.text: They start small. Nobody notices. It always grows.

quiz.question: How do most fraudsters begin?
options: Starting small and escalating when no one notices
Working with organized crime from the start
